notes.title: Autumn Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

It's been a while, but in keeping with our intention to keep our games fresh, we've revisited Firebird.

This update improves a few features, redesigns the docking element to the game, and fixes a couple of reported bugs.

1) The player can now shoot down the alien Big Airburst bombs before they detonate.
2) Improved docking to make it more obvious when the player is aligned with the base.
3) Improved the explosion for terrorists.
4) A failed docking now longer loses a life, you just don't get the bonus.
5) Fixed a few achievements that appear to have been broken in a previous update.

That's it,

We've still got a few plans for a couple of additional features for Firebird, which we hope to release just before Christmas.

Thanks all,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Another Update.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've taken the opportunity to update the launcher for Firebird. Which should see better compatibility?

We've also added the much-requested pause menu, so you get a little bonus as well.

Enjoy,

The jimjams games team.

notes.title: Another day, another update.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've uploaded a small patch today that fixed a rare crash caused by changing some options.

We've also taken this opportunity to improve the alien movement on the very final stage, so the aliens now fly continuously, and weave around the mothership. Improving both the look and the challenge of the level. In addition, we've fixed another rare bug, where sometimes the final level would just loop, instead of increasing difficulty and returning to the first stage.

There's still a possibility that we'll have one more small update before Christmas, so watch this space.

Many thanks for your support.

The JimJams games team.

notes.title: Firebird Christmas update 2018 has landed
notes.notes:
Hi All,

It's nearing that time, and as part of our commitment to keep improving our games, our take on the classic space invasion genre has received an update.

So, what's new?

1) 14 new weapons upgrades, giving the player more ways to kill!
2) 3 New killing spree achievements.
3) An improved, button masher style control system,
4) A new player supercharger for mass destruction.
5) 2 new stages, featuring new aliens
6) More deadly terror attacks as the enemy now deploy explosive drop pods.
7) Improvements to the ship docking stages.
8) Performance improvements.

This build also addresses a couple of small gameplay issues raised by a handful of players, small tweaks mainly, but we're here to please :).

We might have time to release another quick patch before Christmas, as we've not added everything we wanted to for this build, but we need time to update the rest of our range in time for Christmas. 

Enjoy,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: A small update.
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We've updated Firebird, only a couple of small changes, fixing a minor issue and adding the first of many Steam Achievements. Much more to come.

Enjoy,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Firebird quick update.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

In the original build, teleport, thrust and shield were set as pickups, but had keys assigned to activate them, This appears to have caused some confusion for some players. To make it clearer, these addons to the players ship are now available from the start.

These fixes have also given us some cool ideas for some new pickups, so you can expect some additional there soon.

Thanks all,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Firebird - Steam Version incoming!
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We're pleased to annouce that Firebird, our take on the classic space invasion shooter will release on 3rd April 2018.

For Firebird, we've taken our love of the genre and packed all of our favourite features into one chaotic blast fest.

Repel an ever adapting alien invasion force over increasingly challenging, multiple levels.

1) Fight classic style invaders
2) Dodge and weave as they learn to divebomb
3) Watch out for the alien kamikaze drop troops
4) Avoid alien super bombs, which spread shrapnel across the screen
5) Simple, intuitive accelerometer based controls for rapid gameplay
6) Over 25 different play upgrades available
7) Protect yourself with energy shields, advanced drones and ghost ships
8) Blast the enemy in all directions
9) Pick up a smart bomb for instant kills
10) Come face to face with the alien mothership
